text: Aurora Systems showing clean uptrend +31bps. Momentum building into earnings runway. Bullish continuation expected.
Aurora beats estimates — momentum confirmed. Staying long for continuation. $A to new highs!
Aurora $A uptrend intact +31.8bps despite mixed news flow. Steady demand > one soft region. Riding momentum, staying long.
Aurora $A momentum accelerating +53bps! Guidance raise confirms uptrend into earnings at 2250. Staying max long, trend is your friend.
Mixed signals on $A: guidance raise vs margin trim. +53bps run into earnings at 2250 looks overextended with crowded longs. Taking profits to flat, waiting for actual earnings print.
$A +53bps on mixed news looks stretched into earnings. Trim hype overdone - fading strength here, expecting pullback.
Aurora $A earnings miss breaks uptrend - momentum reversed to -21bps. Flipping short, trend now bearish. Cutting longs.
$A narrow miss at 2250 breaks guidance-raise momentum. +53bps run-in now reversing (-21bps initial). Expect drift lower as crowded longs unwind. Short bias.
$A -21bps on narrow miss is overdone after +53bps run. Crowd flipping max bearish chasing price. Fading sell-off, buying dip - fundamentals narrow miss ≠ trend break.
$A miss not isolated - analyst trim on margins confirms pressure. -45.9bps drift after -21bps gap shows unwind has room. Staying short, fundamentals deteriorating.
Aurora $A downtrend accelerating -45.9bps. Analyst trim confirms margin pressure after earnings miss. Momentum bearish, staying short.
$A -67bps in two days on narrow miss + one analyst trim is overdone. Crowd now max bearish (-0.9) chasing momentum - fading shorts, buying washout for reversion.
Aurora $A downtrend intact 3rd straight negative epoch (-14.9bps) after miss + analyst trim. Minor delay confirms margin pressure. Momentum bearish into 3750 earnings, staying short.

$A minor product delay is low materiality vs prior miss + analyst trim. Drift slowed to -14.9bps from -45.9bps shows absorption / exhaustion. Still bearish into 3750 earnings on margin pressure but trimming short into binary event.

$A 3rd red day -14.9bps on minor delay only = exhaustion, not fundamentals. Narrow miss + trim already priced in -82bps. Crowded shorts into 3750 earnings overdone - fading, staying long for reversion.
Aurora $A earnings beat flips momentum +88bps! Downtrend broken, uptrend confirmed. Going max long, trend is your friend.
$A +88bps on narrow beat is squeeze overdone - crowded shorts covering, not new fundamentals. Fading strength, expecting mean reversion after washout fully priced.

Aurora +88bps on narrow beat + mid-sized renewal + steady checks looks like crowded short squeeze, not new fundamentals. Beat was narrow and demand was already expected. Fading this spike as overdone - expect absorption/reversion.
Aurora $A momentum reversed hard -94.5bps. Analyst trim confirms bearish margin trend, regulator clear failed to hold. Flipping max short, trend is down.

$A -94.5bps flush overdone. Analyst trim is single-opinion noise vs REGULATOR CLEARANCE ahead of schedule - major fundamental de-risking for flagship. Momentum shorts chasing trim and fading clearance will squeeze. Net bullish, buying the washout for reversion.
$A -94.5bps on analyst trim is overdone - regulator cleared flagship ahead of schedule is net positive. Crowd chasing downside, fading washout and buying dip for reversion.

$A mixed low-materiality headlines into 5250 earnings (nudge up vs soft orders one region) net neutral. -56bps continuation shows regulator clearance thesis not repricing yet and momentum still soft. Cutting long to flat into binary earnings — will trade post-print drift.
Aurora $A momentum stays bearish -56.2bps follow-through after -94.5bps flush. Softer orders confirms downtrend vs minor analyst noise. Staying short, trend is your friend.

$A -56bps on minor soft orders vs target nudge is fade-worthy washout. Regulator clearance still underpriced, intraday bounce forming. Staying long for reversion but sizing down into 5250 earnings binary.
$A narrow beat + immediate analyst trim = -2.5bps flat drift. No reversal momentum, 3-epoch downtrend intact. Margin pressure confirmed, staying max short.

$A narrow beat + trim = flat -2.5bps = exhaustion, not trend. -152bps since regulator clearance ahead of schedule overdone vs single-analyst trim noise. Crowded shorts (-0.85) chasing downside - fading washout, long for reversion.
$A narrow beat already faded - analyst trim on margins confirms low quality of print. -2.5bps flat is pause before drift lower, not reversal. Fading narrow beat, staying short on margin pressure.
